instruction: Compute net revenue in USD cents for north/widget orders. orders.csv contains revisions: retain only the highest revision per order_id BEFORE filtering region/product/status. Ignore cancelled orders. Subtract returned units from returns.csv (missing means zero; floor net units at zero). Multiply net units by unit_price and the date/currency USD rate from fx.csv. Round EACH order amount to USD cents HALF_UP, then sum integer cents. Return the integer total. Use Python through bash. Work only inside the current directory.
